lines: Homepage & Search team, the surface through which ~80% of all orders were placed.
Worked with product, engineering and design on UI layout, listing size, module ordering and ranking logic.
Analytics covered ~10 million daily active users, using clickstream data.
Evaluated ML-based ranking output; helped identify gaps between algorithm predictions and real user behavior.
Shifted decision-making toward real-time experiment reads, enabling PM + Design to make changes the same day.
words.closing: With so many users, most experiments gave us actionable data in a day. Any choices impacted millions of people, and the impact was real: in NM, on people and in X tweets.

projects.title: Homepage & Search Performance
lines: Maintained and analyzed how homepage and search changes impacted discovery, listing selection and ranking accuracy.
Deployed multiple version changes of homepage and search algorithms and UI.
Identified high-impact modules and reduced UI noise that created empty scroll.
projects.foot: The team's surface: ~10M daily users, ~80% of all orders.

projects.title: Friends Recommendation
lines: Led analytics for Friends Recommendation: social validation of restaurant and food choices.
Led to greater discovery and better recommendations, and gave us much more signal on how users connect.
Helped us create our own social graph, starting with a billion-plus nodes.

rescue.title: Food Rescue
rescue.kicker: One cancelled order, event by event

steps.title: Order cooked
steps.line: The meal is made. Its cost is already spent.

steps.title: Rider on the way
steps.line: The rider heads to the first address.

steps.title: Customer cancels
steps.line: The meal is cooked, packed and on the road.
steps.why: About 400,000 orders a month ended here, with the food thrown away.

steps.title: Offer goes out nearby
steps.line: People near the rider can claim the same meal. Closest buyer first.
steps.why: Rule: whoever cancelled, and the people next to them, never get the offer.

steps.title: A neighbour claims it
steps.line: A ₹322 meal for ₹175, freshly made and sealed.

steps.title: Rider is rerouted
steps.line: A short detour to the new address. The rider is paid in full for it.

steps.title: Meal delivered
steps.line: Eaten a few streets away, not thrown away.

offer.caption: The offer, as it showed in the app

result.caption: less food waste across India
result.press: Covered by Times of India, NDTV and Verdict Foodservice

gains.text: A fresh meal in minutes, at a steep discount
The meal is eaten, not thrown away
Paid in full for the detour

myPart.title: My part
lines: Ran experiments and A/B tests to learn what customers prefer and how the discount's size changes buying (discount elasticity).
Did the analytics behind what discount to show, to whom, and for how long.
Tuned how the offer is broadcast (over MQTT): the wait between waves and the radius it reaches.
Added new rules and studied fraud, so a cancelled order could not be turned into a discount.
